stories.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範

sources.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
sources.title_zh: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
sources.title_original: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
sources.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

sources.title: 作為一家規模龐大的搜尋引擎，ChatGPT 現在面臨歐盟更嚴格的監管。 / ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
sources.title_zh: 作為一家規模龐大的搜尋引擎，ChatGPT 現在面臨歐盟更嚴格的監管。
sources.title_en: ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
sources.title_original: ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
sources.summary: The EU Commission is classifying ChatGPT as a very large search engine under the Digital Services Act for the first time, with at least 45 million monthly EU users. By the end of 2026, OpenAI has to deliver risk assessments, transparency reports, and an ad archive, among other things. Whether the Commission can also demand access to training data is disputed among legal experts. The article ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 歐盟委員會首次依據《數位服務法》將ChatGPT歸類為超大型搜尋引擎，其歐盟月活躍用戶至少達4,500萬。 2026年底，OpenAI必須提交風險評估報告、透明度報告和廣告存檔等資料。歐盟委員會是否也有權要求其提供培訓數據，目前法律專家對此存在爭議。本文《ChatGPT作為超大型搜尋引擎，如今面臨更嚴格的歐盟監管》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.title: OpenAI 僅在其人工智慧真正發揮作用時才開始向部分客戶收費 / OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 僅在其人工智慧真正發揮作用時才開始向部分客戶收費
sources.title_en: OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
sources.title_original: OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
sources.summary: OpenAI is offering some large customers outcome-based pricing, where they pay only once the AI actually finishes a task. Salesforce, Adobe, and several startups are also moving away from fixed subscription fees. The central dispute stays the same. Who gets credit for the success, the software or the customer? The article OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 為部分大型客戶提供以結果為基礎的定價模式，即只有在人工智慧實際完成任務後才需付費。 Salesforce、Adobe 和多家新創公司也正在逐步取消固定訂閱費用。核心爭議依然存在：成功的功勞究竟歸於軟體還是客戶？本文《OpenAI 開始僅在人工智慧實際運作後才向部分客戶收費》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title_en: Instagram admits users often can't tell AI profiles from real people
sources.title_original: Instagram admits users often can't tell AI profiles from real people
sources.summary: Instagram is replacing its "AI creator" tag with a new "AI-generated profile" label because users can't tell AI profiles from real people. sources.summary: According to The Information, OpenAI has purchased tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios to train computer agents. Anthropic also relies on Apple hardware. Demand is so high that the most powerful models have been sold out for months. Apple’s Mac revenue rose by nearly 29 percent to $10.4 billion in the June quarter. The article OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據The Information通報，OpenAI已購買數萬臺Mac mini和Mac Studio用於訓練電腦智慧體。 Anthropic也依賴蘋果的硬體。由於需求旺盛，效能最強的機型已售罄數月。 蘋果的的Mac產品在6月季度的營收成長了近29%，達到104億美元。文章《OpenAI及其競爭對手的AI實驗室正在採購數萬臺Mac mini以訓練電腦智慧體》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

stories.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模

sources.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
sources.title_zh: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
sources.title_original: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
sources.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

sources.title: Gradium AI 發布全新預設 TTS 模型：硬性案例通過率達 81.0%，首次音訊播放時間僅需 216 毫秒 / Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio
sources.title_zh: Gradium AI 發布全新預設 TTS 模型：硬性案例通過率達 81.0%，首次音訊播放時間僅需 216 毫秒
sources.title_en: Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio
sources.title_original: Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio
sources.summary: Speed and accuracy usually pull against each other in text-to-speech. Gradium AI's new default model reports both: an 81.0% human-rated pass rate on 500 hard sentences across five languages, at 216 ms P50 time-to-first-audio on Coval. The evaluation set is open on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0. The post Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 在文字轉語音領域，速度和準確度通常難以兼顧。 Gradium AI 的全新預設模型卻兼顧了這兩點：在五種語言的 500 個複雜句子上，其人工評分通過率高達 81.0%，Coval 測試的 P50 首次音訊播放時間僅為 216 毫秒。此評估資料集已在 Hugging Face 上開源，並遵循 CC BY 4.0 授權協議。本文最初發佈於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Gradium AI 發布全新預設 TTS 模型：複雜句子通過率高達 81.0%，首次音訊播放時間僅 216 毫秒」。

stories.news_summary: Keenable AI 開源 NEEDLE，這是一個即時搜尋基準測試工具，每小時重建查詢集，以應對搜尋代理可能透過下載公開數據集來規避檢索的評估漏洞。

sources.title_zh: OpenClaw 2.0 帶來了簡化的設定、重新設計的瀏覽器應用程式以及多人遊戲模式。
sources.title_en: OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
sources.title_original: OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
sources.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released version 2.0 of its open-source AI platform, its largest release to date with over 16,000 pull requests. New features include cloud sessions on rented machines, real-time collaboration, and a browser app rebuilt from scratch. The software now automatically detects existing resources like API keys and AI subscriptions during setup. The article OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了其開源 AI 平臺 2.0 版本，這是迄今為止最大的版本更新，包含了超過 16,000 個 pull request。新功能包括在租用機器上進行雲端會話、即時協作以及完全重構的瀏覽器應用程式。該軟體現在可以在設定過程中自動偵測現有資源，例如 API 金鑰和 AI 訂閱。文章《OpenClaw 2.0 帶來簡化的設定、重構的瀏覽器應用程式和多人會話》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.summary: OpenAI週末宣佈計畫在今年11月12日終止直接向AI輔助程式開發工具Cursor提供OpenAI模型的合約，可能和SpaceX收購Cursor有關。 OpenAI計畫結束對Cursor提供AI模型的合約，他們已對Cursor說明2026年11月12日之前為過渡期。在過渡期間，該公司仍然會提供Cursor存取現今正在使用的模型，但對方也可以選擇提早結束存取。OpenAI會在雙方確認後公佈合約終止日期。

stories.title: Google AI發布TimesFM-3：一個擁有3.3億參數的多元時間序列預測零樣本基礎模型 / Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

sources.title: Google AI發布TimesFM-3：一個擁有3.3億參數的多元時間序列預測零樣本基礎模型 / Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
sources.title_zh: Google AI發布TimesFM-3：一個擁有3.3億參數的多元時間序列預測零樣本基礎模型
sources.title_en: Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
sources.title_original: Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
sources.summary: Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a 330 million parameter time series foundation model that forecasts multiple related series in a single forward pass. Unlike every TimesFM checkpoint through 2.5, it is pretrained natively for multivariate forecasting, accepting multiple targets, past covariates, and past-future covariates with no task-specific fine-tuning. It takes the top average rank among pretrained foundation models on GIFT-Eval, fev-bench, and the TIME leaderboard. The weights, however, ship under a non-commercial, non-production license. The post Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Google Research 發布了 TimesFM-3，這是一個擁有 3.3 億參數的時間序列基礎模型，可在一次前向傳播中預測多個相關序列。與 2.5 版本之前的所有 TimesFM 版本不同，TimesFM-3 已針對多元預測進行了原生預訓練，無需針對特定任務進行微調，即可接受多個目標值、歷史協變量以及過去-未來協變量。它在 GIFT-Eval、fev-bench 和 TIME 排行榜上，在所有預訓練基礎模型中均名列前茅。然而，其權重以非商業、非生產許可發布。本文最初發表於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google AI 發布 TimesFM-3：用於多元時間序列預測的 3.3 億參數零樣本基礎模型」。

sources.summary: OpenAI will soon be held accountable for mitigating risks related to ChatGPT's impact on minors, user mental health, and the spread of illegal content in the European Union. That's because ChatGPT is now considered a Very Large Online Search Engine under the EU's Digital Services Act, a set of laws regulating major online services and […]
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 很快將承擔起減輕 ChatGPT's 對未成年人、使用者心理健康以及在歐盟傳播非法內容所帶來的風險的責任。這是因為根據歐盟《數位服務法》，ChatGPT 現在被認定為超大型線上搜尋引擎。 《數位服務法》是一套監管大型線上服務的法律。 […]

sources.summary: Debian voted to allow developers to use AI tools in their contributions to the Linux distribution's "development, maintenance, [and] documentation." The new policy on AI acknowledges that "responsible" use of AI can improve developers' productivity, and goes on to say, "generative AI is neither exempt from nor subject to special rules beyond the standards already […]

sources.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot. It's also renaming the "AI creator" label to "AI-generated profile" to make it clear when a profile features an AI-generated person that's not a real human being. "We've heard that people don't like seeing a profile […]
sources.summary_zh: Instagram 終於開始採取措施應對日益猖獗的虛假 AI 網紅帳號，這些帳號越來越難以辨識。 Instagram 也將“AI 建立者”標籤更名為“AI 生成的個人資料”，以便明確區分哪些個人資料中的人物是由 AI 生成的，而非真人。 “我們瞭解到使用者不喜歡看到這樣的個人資料…”

stories.title: 本地AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷

sources.title: 本地AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷
sources.title_zh: 本地AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷
sources.title_original: 本地AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷
sources.summary: 本地AI模型工具LM Studio推出的AI代理應用Bionic，新增Shell指令自動審查功能Auto Review。Bionic可使用本地或雲端的開放模型處理程式開發、文件等工作，當AI代理準備執行Shell指令時，Auto Review會先以程式分析辨識可安全執行的操作，無法完整判斷時才交由獨立的審查代理處理，減少使用者逐一確認指令的情況。

sources.title: 阿里巴巴 表示，Qwen3.8-Max 在商業代理基準測試中領先開放權重模型 / Alibaba says Qwen3.8-Max leads open-weight models on commerce agent benchmark
sources.title_zh: 阿里巴巴 表示，Qwen3.8-Max 在商業代理基準測試中領先開放權重模型
sources.title_en: Alibaba says Qwen3.8-Max leads open-weight models on commerce agent benchmark
sources.title_original: Alibaba says Qwen3.8-Max leads open-weight models on commerce agent benchmark
sources.summary: The Accio team's state-based benchmark reports Qwen3.8-Max completing 56 tasks through Accio, 47 through OpenClaw and 53 through Pi; Alibaba calls it the strongest overall open-weight result.
sources.summary_zh: Accio 團隊基於狀態的基準測試報告顯示，Qwen3.8-Max 透過 Accio 完成了 56 項任務，透過 OpenClaw 完成了 47 項任務，透過 Pi 完成了 53 項任務；阿里巴巴 稱其為最強的整體開放權重結果。

sources.title_en: You Know Who Really Hates AI? Insurance Claims Adjusters
sources.title_original: You Know Who Really Hates AI? Insurance Claims Adjusters
sources.summary: Of the Glassdoor reviews from claims adjusters that mentioned AI, a staggering 98 percent were negative. “AI is just a tool,” one person tells WIRED. “It should never be given the keys.”
sources.summary_zh: 在Glassdoor上，理賠員提及人工智慧的評論中，高達98%都是負面的。 “人工智慧只是一種工具，”一位用戶告訴《連線》雜誌，“絕不應該賦予它控制權。”
